μακρόν: μακρός — long; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δόρυ: ’long’

μείλινον: μείλινος — of ash-wood, ashen; adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun
μελίη: μελίη — ash tree; spear of ash-wood; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic μελία)

μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)

μοῖρα: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg. · also with an inf., ’it is fated’ (μοῖρα θανεῖν ’fated to die’)

νήπιε: νήπιος — foolish, childish, simple; masc. voc. sg., in reproachful address: ’foolish one’
νεφέων: νέφος — cloud; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεφῶν)

νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νυκτὸς: νύξ — night; fem. gen. sg., gen. of comparison (after ἀμείνω) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἀμολγῷ: ’of night’ (νυκτὸς ἀμολγῷ ’in the dead of night’)
νόον: νόος — mind, understanding; masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic νοῦν)
νόσφιν: νόσφιν — apart, far off, away; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’apart from, without’
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
οἰωνοὶ: οἰωνός — bird of prey, bird of omen; masc. nom. pl.

οἴκαδ: οἴκαδε (elided οἴκαδ’) — homeward, to home; adv., -δε suffix of direction
οἴμησε: οἰμάω — dart, swoop; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented form: ’darted’

οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even

οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
οὐρανῷ: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. dat. sg.
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
πάλαι: πάλαι — long ago, of old; adv.
πάλλεν: πάλλω — shake, brandish; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπαλλε): ’shook’

πατρόκλοιο: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ companion; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)

περισσείοντο: περισσείω — shake about; impf. 3 pl. pass., epic, unaugmented (= Attic περιεσείοντο): ’were shaken about’

σέ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’you’

στέρνοιο: στέρνον — chest, breast; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
στιβαρόν: στιβαρός — stout, massive, sturdy; neut. nom./acc. sg.

ἐγγύθι: ἐγγύθι — near, close by; adv., + gen.: ’near Priam’s’
ἐθέλῃ: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 3 sg., after ὁππότε: ’is willing’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’) · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
ἐλάαν: ἐλαύνω — drive; epic pres. inf. of the by-form ἐλάω, with diectasis (contracted ἐλᾶν; Attic pres. inf. ἐλαύνειν): ’to drive on’
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’) · also neut. voc. sg., in address: ’my’ (τέκνον ἐμὸν ’my child’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνέπρησεν: ἐμπίπρημι — set on fire, burn; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable, with κεν in a past unreal apodosis: ’would have burned’
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — in this place, to this place; adv.
ἐνθεμένη: ἐντίθημι — put in, lay upon; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having laid’
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξενάριξε: ἐξεναρίζω — slay and strip of arms; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’killed and stripped’
ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπέφνομεν: ἔπεφνον — slay (aor. of the root of φόνος; no present in use); aor. 1 pl. ἐπέφνομεν, reduplicated: ’we slew’
ἐπεύξατο: ἐπεύχομαι — pray to, vow; vaunt over, boast; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’vaunted’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
ἐρύσσατο: ἐρύω — draw, pull out; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σσ-: ’drew out’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’)
ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: ’good, brave’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(it is) good’ (ἐσθλὸν … τέτυκται)
ἐσσομένοισι: εἰμί — be; fut. part. masc. dat. pl., epic ἐσσομένοισι (= Attic ἐσομένοις): ’to those yet to be’
ἐσύλα: συλάω — strip off, take away; impf. 3 sg.: ’stripped off’
ἐτώσιον: ἐτώσιος — vain, fruitless; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in vain’ · also neut. nom./acc. sg., adj. agreeing with ἄχθος: ’useless’
ἐφάμην: φημί — say, think; impf. mid. 1 sg. (= Attic ἔφην): ’I said, I thought’
ἐόντ: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. acc. dual, elided (ἐόντ’ = ἐόντε), epic (= Attic ὄντε): ’being’ · also masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐόντ’ = ἐόντα), agreeing with Πάτροκλον: ’being’
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἑκηβόλῳ: ἑκηβόλος — far-shooting (ἑκάς + βάλλω), epithet of Apollo; masc. dat. sg.
ἑταίρου: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. gen. sg., of cause with ἀχνύμενος: ’for the comrade’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of a companion’ (παραίφασις ἑταίρου ’a companion’s persuasion’) · also masc. gen. sg. after παρά: ’from a companion’ (παρ’ ἑταίρου) · also masc. gen. sg., object of ἀμέλησεν: ’neglect his companion’ · also masc. gen. sg., in a genitive absolute with a participle: ’as the companion called’ (ἑταίρου κικλήσκοντος)
ἑῇ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive; epic ἑός) — his own, her own; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with a fem. noun: ’own’
ἔα: ἐάω — let be, allow, leave alone; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’leave alone!’ · also εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἔα (= Attic ἦν): ’I was’ · also ἐάω — allow; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= εἴα): ’allowed’
ἔασεν: ἐάω — allow, let be; aor. 3 sg. act., epic (= Attic εἴασεν)
ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment needed: ’recognised’ · also gnomic aor. 3 sg.: ’learns’ (ῥεχθὲν … ἔγνω ’learns when it is done’)
ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔγωγ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε, elided (ἔγωγ’ = ἔγωγε): ’I for my part’
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔδμεναι: ἔδω — eat; pres. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐσθίειν): ’to eat’
ἔδωκαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl. augmented (κ-aorist): ’they gave’
ἔθειραι: ἔθειρα — hair; mane of a horse, plume of a helmet; fem. nom. pl.: ’plumes’
ἔκφυγε: ἐκφεύγω — flee out, escape; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐξέφυγε)
ἔλασ: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg. act., elided epic (ἔλασ’ = ἔλασσε): ’struck’
ἔμελλον: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 pl. · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I was destined, was about to’ + fut. inf.
ἔοργας: ἔρδω (= ῥέζω) — do, perform; perf. 2 sg. act. (ἔοργα): ’you have done’
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’at, against’ (Τυδεΐδῃ ἔπι … τόξα τιταίνετο ’drew his bow at Tydeides’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’by, along’ (ὁδῷ ἔπι ’by the road’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’at’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’at the hollow ships’, with ὀλέκονται) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + gen. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νήσων ἔπι ’to the islands’)
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔσθ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἔσθ’ = ἔστι before a rough breathing)
ἔσσεσθ: εἰμί — be; fut. inf., epic ἔσσεσθαι (= Attic ἔσεσθαι), elided: ’to be’
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔφης: φημί — say, declare; impf. 2 sg.: ’you said’
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’ · also impf. 3 sg., ’had as wife, was married to’ (θυγατέρα ἔχε ’had the daughter to wife’)
ἔχουσι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they hold’
ἔχουσιν: ἔχω — have, hold, occupy; pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they hold’
ἕκτορ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. voc. sg., in address · also masc. acc. sg., epic elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορα), object of σχήσουσι: ’Hector’ (πελώριον Ἕκτορ’ ’huge Hector’) · also masc. dat. sg., elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορι), after ἅμα: ’with Hector’ (ἅμ’ Ἕκτορ’ ἴσαν ’went with Hector’)
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., opponent after μάχομαι: ’with Hector’; and after χωρέω: ’to Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. after a verb of anger: ’with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with ὑπό, of those before whom men flee: ’before Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with πειράω, the opponent: ’(make trial) with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., the person deprived: ’(taken) from Hector’
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἡγήτορες: ἡγήτωρ — leader, chief; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’leaders!’ · also masc. nom. pl., subject of ἧντ’: ’leaders (were sitting)’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’) · also ἤ = ἦ, interrogative particle opening a direct question: ’can it be that …?’ (ἤ ῥ’ ἔτι που σχήσουσι … ’can they still, I wonder, hold back …?’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or adverb of degree (ἤ περ ’than’) · also ἤ … ἦ, introducing a deliberative alternative: ’(shall I) … or …’ (ἤ μιν … θείω … ἦ … δαμάσσω) · also ἤ = ἦ with μοι in a self-addressed question: ’why indeed …?’ (τί ἤ μοι)
ἤλυθ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἤλυθ’ = ἤλυθε), epic (= Attic ἦλθε)
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤριπε: ἐρείπω — throw down; in the intransitive aor. ἤριπον, fall headlong, crash down; aor. 3 sg.: ’fell headlong’
ἥβην: ἥβη — youth, prime of youth; fem. acc. sg. · also Ἥβη — Hebe, goddess of youth; fem. acc. sg.
ἥφαιστος: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἵει: ἵημι — send, let go, throw; impf. 3 sg.: ’sent’ · also ἵημι — put, set; impf. 3 sg., with ἐν: ’put in’ (ἐν … ἵει ’put in (the traces)’) · ἵημι — send, hurl; pres. imper. 2 sg. act., with ἐν in tmesis: ’hurl in, let loose’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’) · also + opt., in a purpose clause after a past verb: ’so that … might’ (ἵνα μή … ἵκοιτο ’so that … might not come’)
ἵσταται: ἵστημι — set, make stand; mid. stand; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’stands’
ὀλιγοδρανέων: ὀλιγοδρανέω — be feeble, have little strength; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= Attic ὀλιγοδρανῶν)
ὀξύ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg.
ὀρώρῃ: ὄρνυμι — rouse, set in motion; perf. subj. 3 sg. (of ὄρωρα ’have risen, am stirred’), intrans.: ’be stirring’
ὁππότε: ὁππότε — when; temporal conj., epic doubled π (= ὁπότε)
ὁρμήθη: ὁρμάομαι — set out, rush, start; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’rushed’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλεθρος: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin; masc. nom. sg.
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’) · also temporal, ’until’ + aor. subj., without ἄν (ὄφρ’ ἀνέληται ’until she takes (him) up’) · also ὄφρα + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … ὤσαιτο ’so that he might drive back’)
ὄφρά: ὄφρα — so that, until, while; conj., epic (= Attic ἵνα, ἕως); with the subj.: ’so that’ (accent from the following enclitic) · also ὄφρα + indic., temporal: ’so long as’ (ὄφρά οἱ αἷμ’ … ἀνήνοθεν ’so long as the blood welled’) · also ὄφρα + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρά σφιν … ῥύοιτο ’so that it might protect for them’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅπῃ: ὅπῃ — where, whither, in whatever way; relative adv., also in an indirect question: ’how, in what way’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’) · also ὅς (τε) as an indirect interrogative without τις: ’who’ (ὅς τε πεφεύγοι ’who had fled’)
ὅσ: ὅσος — as much/many as; relative correlative pron., neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσ’ = ὅσα)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὅττί: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; neut. acc. sg. ὅττι (doubled τ), accented before the enclitic κεν · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οὐδέ τι ᾔδη ὅττι … ’nor did he know that …’) · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that, because’, giving the cause of anger (χώσατο … ὅττι ’was incensed that’) · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of rejoicing, accented before the enclitic οἱ (γήθησέν τε ὅττί … ’rejoiced that …’) · also ὅττι = ὅ τι, interrogative neut. nom. sg. in an indirect question, agreeing with πένθος: ’what (grief)’
ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχε’ ἀκούω ’I hear shameful things about you’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’) · also prep. + φι-form of place: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ ζυγόφι ’from under the yoke’)
ὠκὺ: ὠκύς — swift, quick; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤκιστος: ὠκύς — swift; superlative ὤκιστος: ’swiftest’; masc. nom. sg.
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ὧς: ὥς — thus, so; adv. (printed ὧς, = ὣς; Attic οὕτως)
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., with ἔπι: ’on account of which’ (ᾗ ἔπι ’for which’) · also possessive, agreeing with κεφαλῇ: ’his own’ (ᾗ κεφαλῇ)
ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= ἑῇσιν) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= Attic αἷς): ’in which’
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with which’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., of the person affected: ’about whom’ (ᾧ … περὶ ῥόπαλ’ ἐάγῃ ’about whom clubs are broken’) · also relative, neut. dat. sg., object of ἐπέπιθμεν: ’in which’ (ᾧ ἐπέπιθμεν ’in which we trusted’)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥέξας: ῥέζω — do, perform (a sacrifice); aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having performed’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥεθέων: ῥέθος — limb; neut. pl. limbs; gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ῥεθῶν)
